release_schedule.rule: The WCO prepares amendments updating the HS nomenclature every 5-6 years through the Review Sub-Committee and HS Committee; the HS Convention provides a two-and-one-half-year implementation period after adoption before a new edition enters into force (six months for reservations, two years for correlation tables/translation/legislative updates). The HS2022 edition entered into force 1 January 2022; the next edition, originally planned as HS2027, was pushed back one year due to COVID-19-related delays and will be HS2028, entering into force 1 January 2028.
release_schedule.note: This is a periodic amendment/nomenclature update, not a recurring data report with dated calendar entries. The WCO's own site frames it as a 5-6 year revision cycle governed by the HS Convention's implementation timeline rather than a fixed calendar. It is the full accounting basis beside the simplified 小企业会计准则, and yearbooks name the pair together: their 主要统计指标解释 for enterprise financial indicators (资产总计, 负债合计, 固定资产合计, 销售费用, 营业利润) tell the reader which line of the enterprise's own 资产负债表 or 利润表 to take 执行《企业会计准则》或《小企业会计准则》的企业. NODE CAVEAT on the URL: the Ministry's own pages for 令第76号 (tfs.mof.gov.cn/caizhengbuling/201407/t20140729_1119494.htm) and for the 2006 issue on kjs.mof.gov.cn answered 502 from the Ministry's CDN to the cloud container and to the built-in browser pane on 2026-09-10 (the kjs.mof.gov.cn page cited by cn-mof-small-enterprise-accounting-standards, read fine in round 42, 502'd the same way), so the cited page is the State Council Gazette's printing of 令第76号 with the amended 基本准则 in full (国务院公报 2014年第31号 on gov.cn) — the same route as cn-foreign-contracted-projects-regulations and cn-mee-hazardous-waste-list-2016; move the URL to the Ministry's page when it answers. MATCHER NOTE: the alias 企业会计准则 is a substring of 小企业会计准则, so a document naming only the small-enterprise standard would also satisfy namesTarget for this node — every edge here quotes a sentence naming both, and a future edge should do the same. Minted round 43 off three independent yearbook citations (Suzhou, Guangdong, Xi'an) after round 40 opened the lead.
targetReport.cadence_note: A standing standard, issued 2006 and amended once in 2014; not reissued on a cycle. The 42 specific standards beneath it are separate instruments.
